title: バイオ工学入門
subtitle: Introduction to Bioengineering
educationalGoal: Introducing the history of biotechnology used in industry, old biotechnology and new biotechnology. There is a wide range of application fields of biotechnology such as food, chemicals, medical products, environmental restoration, measurement, and energy, and students mainly learn the principles and theories of technological development.
advice: This is a basic molecular biology course. We will cover the following topics: 1. Biotechnology food 2. Biotechnology environment 3. Biotechnology medical 4. Biotechnology measurement 5. Biotechnology material Students should have completed the “Basic Biology” course. Students are required to actively participate in class.
requiredKnowledge: Requires completion of the “Basic Biology” course.

Ability to explain biotechnology in the medical field.
